speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. To better understand your symptoms, can you tell me if you have noticed any scaling, crusting, or specific patterns on your palms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of scarring/blisters on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body) and sensorimotor neuropathy in a patient with potential iron overload (livestock/rice farming) is highly suggestive of PCT, often triggered by alcohol, hepatitis C, or hemochromatosis. I will now request specific tests to confirm this. REQUEST TEST: Serum Ferritin, CBC, Liver Function Tests, and Hepatitis C Antibody. REQUEST IMAGES: Photos of the rash showing blistering or scarring on the dorsal hands and face.
